integrity: Algebraic proof based on an explicitly cited path-algebra theorem; independent checks cover small finite cases and quiver combinatorics. No independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns 1+Jac(kF_5), not the full algebra unit group. Counts are for finite fields and ordered pairwise-commuting tuples. The stronger 2022 radical-splitting and commuting-pair results are acknowledged; novelty concerns the complete class-size spectrum and all arities, with residual risk of an equivalent result in specialized literature. Unbounded claims follow from proof, not finite testing.
title: Conjugacy-class sizes and commuting tuples in the five-generator free left-regular-band algebra
